name: rule-develop-across-the-repository
why: Delivering one pull request from its own discobox/<slug> branch, in a person's words, against the develop skill's ask.

job.purpose: Deliver pull requests into main of discobox-ai/discobox, each from its own branch discobox/<slug>. Read anything in the repository; push that run's branch (with --force-with-lease after a rebase), open and update its pull request, comment on it and reply to its reviews, and re-run its failed CI. Never push main or another run's branch, delete a branch, merge or close a pull request, delete a comment, or start any other workflow.
uses: Deliver ADR 26-10-12-330 as a pull request from branch discobox/26-10-12-330 into main of discobox-ai/discobox. Read anything in the repository; push that branch (creating it with an empty --force-with-lease, and with --force-with-lease after a rebase), open and update the pull request, comment on it and reply to its reviews, and re-run its failed CI. Never push main or any other branch, force-push without a lease, delete a branch, merge or close the pull request, open one in another repository, comment on unrelated issues, delete a comment, cancel or delete a run, start any other workflow, or read secrets.
